title: Backwards Clock
description: A scheduling slot where the end time is before the start time makes no physical sense on a calendar. Confirm the assignment upsert rejects that ordering rather than accepting a shipment that arrives before it departs.
successCondition: Book a shipment, then PUT /api/fleet/assignments/:shipmentId as a dispatcher with a real vehicleId/driverId, scheduledStart set to "2026-09-01T10:00:00.000Z", and scheduledEnd set to "2026-09-01T08:00:00.000Z" (before scheduledStart) returns 400 with error.code VALIDATION_ERROR referencing scheduledEnd.
hints: The schema-level refine check explicitly requires scheduledStart to be strictly before scheduledEnd — equal timestamps should also fail this check, worth trying as a boundary case too.
Both timestamps must otherwise be valid ISO 8601 datetime strings, or you'll get a different validation error unrelated to the ordering.
